name: Issum (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and red in the proportions 1:5:1, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Issum (a stag on red).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Düsseldorf of 27 June 1973 the municipality of Issum was granted the right to bear arms, a seal and a banner, described as red-white-red 1:5:1 striped lengthwise with the arms shifted slightly above the centre.
